webview.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/157.0.0.0

buildMode: Native Windows x64 release, embedded production assets, isolated app identifier/profile, no original accounts
ordering: Baseline 20 repetitions/workload, candidate 20/workload, then baseline control 20/workload to investigate observed nonstationary timing. Same fixture, alternating workload order per repetition. Not randomized per-arm.

primary.metric: UI-thread TaskDuration for fixed 12-key typing batch at 5000 mixed messages

checks: Browser text find reaches the first historical message through content-visibility
Cross-history selection retains all 1000 messages and formatted code
Copy returns the real response; typing preserves historical DOM and open disclosure
Historical link stays keyboard reachable; local image loads, enlarges and restores focus
Streaming updates the latest body without replacing or collapsing historical messages
Compact handoff remains reachable without starting generation
Memoized message actions use the latest chat after navigation, not captured old state
Both comparison messages retain adjacent lane grouping and distinct visible bodies
acceptance.scope: Native Windows release, synthetic fixtures. No screen-reader certification, external-editor launch, provider inference or universal accessibility claim.

scrollInvestigation.scope: 5000 mixed, fixed full DOM, no typing/streaming between scroll trials; A/B/A/B, warmup plus20 trials per launch

excludedPrototype.scope: Per-message memoization in addition to transcript isolation

scroll.scope: 5000 mixed, fixed full DOM, no typing/streaming between scroll trials; A/B/A/B, warmup plus20 trials per launch

excludedPrototype.decision: Not integrated: unexplained scrolling differences prompted narrowing to transcript/composer isolation only

limits: No paid/model calls; prior live budget unchanged
Synthetic warm-host workload; first-process launch is one sample per arm, not cold OS or startup acceptance
TaskDuration includes renderer work beyond JavaScript. The key-after-frame proxy is not INP or presentation feedback
Private bytes sampled only twice per workload/arm, excluding shared working sets; JS heap follows ordinary GC
Full transcript DOM preserved; no virtualization or initial-mount scaling improvement claimed
No provider handshake/inference latency, full-release packaging/CI, non-Windows GUI or screen-reader certification
